Aurora

Find the shards.
Wake the portal.

Guide a small astronaut through mazes floating beneath the northern lights. Every level hides three star shards. Collect them all to wake the portal, then get there before your hearts run out. Lasers sweep the paths, spikes pulse from the floor, crumbling tiles fall away, and in Chapter 2 insects hunt you through a jungle island.

PLAY AURORA →

No game download. Plays in a desktop browser with keyboard and mouse or a controller. WebGL and JavaScript are required.

How to playChaptersControlsRelics & medalsQuestions

Your first level

Three shards, one portal.

Each level is a maze of floating tiles. Explore it to find the three glowing star shards; the minimap fills in as you go. Once you hold all three, the portal wakes up and a beam of light shows you where it is. Step inside to finish the level.

  1. Watch your hearts. Hazards and falls into the void cost a heart. Lose them all and you restart from your last shard.
  2. Learn the hazards. Jump over rotating lasers, wait for spike traps to retract, cross crumbling tiles quickly, ride moving platforms and launch off bounce pads.
  3. Beat the par time. Every level has a par time. Finish fast for a gold, silver or bronze medal, and replay levels to improve your best time.

Dash on selected levels

Some levels let you dash: a quick burst forward that uses stamina and recharges in one second. These levels show a dash icon in level select and explain the dash when you first open them.

A countdown for speedrunners

Turn on Start Countdown in General Settings for a 3-2-1-GO before each run. The timer only starts on GO.

Two journeys

Aurora's chapters

Chapter 1: The Aurora

Seven crystal mazes adrift in the void: The Drift, Nebula Gardens, The Core, Shattered Halo, Laser Garden, Aurora's Heart and the 25×25 Level Impossible, full of lasers, spikes and drones with only two hearts.

Chapter 2: The Wilds

A living island under the stars, currently a demo. In Whispering Grove, trees form the maze walls, thorn traps hide in the grass and insects spot you, chase you and lunge. Clear every level of Chapter 1 to unlock it.

Know your keys

Aurora controls

Keyboard and mouse controls, with the matching controller button in brackets.
W A S DMove (left stick)
MouseLook around (right stick)
SpaceJump; hold for a higher jump (✕)
ShiftSprint (R2)
FDash on dash levels (○)
EPick up a shard when Auto Pickup is off (▢)
TabRecords, Collection and relic Powers (touchpad)
RRespawn at your last checkpoint
EscPause (Options)

Aurora has full PlayStation DualSense and standard controller support with rumble. Settings let you change sensitivity, invert the camera, turn controller button icons off, and adjust graphics quality, field of view and volume.

Off the main path

Relics, powers and medals

Hidden relics

Every level hides relics, each with its own design, and they move to a new spot on every run. A relic joins your Collection when you finish the level with it.

Relic powers

Open the Powers tab during a level to spend a relic. A glowing trail appears on the ground and leads you to the nearest star shard, or to the portal, for one minute. You can spend up to two relics per run, only from the chapter you're playing, and a spent relic goes back into hiding until you find it again.

Medals and records

Beat a level's par time for gold, silver or bronze. The Records tab shows your best and average times, your last ten runs and your deaths.

Before you launch

Aurora questions

Is Aurora free?
Yes. Aurora is free to play in your browser on Unpaused, with no game download needed.
How do I unlock Chapter 2?
Clear every level of Chapter 1. Chapter 2, The Wilds, then opens in the chapter select.
Can I play Aurora with a controller?
Yes. Aurora supports PlayStation and other standard controllers, including rumble. You can hide the controller button icons in Settings if you only use keyboard and mouse.
Is my progress saved?
Yes. Unlocked levels, best times, medals, relics and settings are saved in your browser on this device.
What do I need to run it?
An up-to-date desktop browser with WebGL and hardware acceleration turned on. Lower the graphics quality in Display settings if it runs slowly.
Can I play on a phone?
Aurora is made for desktop play with keyboard and mouse or a controller. This guide is readable on a phone, but the game has no touch controls.
